svg.title: Подъём носков на себя у стены — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing wall-supported toe raise (ankle dorsiflexion). Side view. Both shoulders and hips touch same vertical wall, feet slightly forward of wall, straight-ish knees. START both soles flat. END both heels stay firmly on same floor line, the front of both shoes and toes visibly angle UP above floor, heel DOWN. Do not raise heels. Include wall and floor lines. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
